verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document speech-to-text transcription of voice notes, text-to-speech replies, or live voice conversation in LobeChat. Two items come close but do not qualify. The Agents marketplace lists 'voice' as a category of community agents, which is not the product's own voice input or output. 'Multimodal input' for Gemini is a model capability, not a documented voice feature.

support.subject: As a power user, I can interact by voice — voice notes get transcribed, replies can be spoken, or live voice conversations are supported
